title: Chicken and Mango Salad
subtitle: Poached chicken and ripe mango in a chilli-lime dressing
excerpt: Shredded poached chicken with ripe mango strips, cucumber, spring onion and coriander, dressed in a sharp lime, fish sauce and chilli dressing. A Thai-influenced main-course salad that works as a light dinner.
sourceNotes: Chicken and mango salad with a Southeast Asian-influenced dressing became a feature of British restaurant and cafe menus in the 1990s and 2000s, as Thai and Vietnamese flavours entered the mainstream. The combination of poached or rotisserie chicken with ripe mango and a lime-fish sauce dressing draws on Thai yam (warm salad) traditions adapted for a Western format.

recipe.makeAheadNotes: Poach the chicken up to a day ahead. Assemble just before serving; mango and cucumber release water quickly.

content.text: Chicken and mango salad works when the mango is ripe enough to be deeply sweet and the dressing is sharp enough to cut through it. The lime-and-fish-sauce dressing follows Thai yam principles: sour, salty, sweet and hot in balance. Use a ripe mango that gives when pressed and smells fruity at the base; a hard, pale mango will make the salad disappointing. The chilli is optional but adds the heat that makes the dressing lively.

items.prepNote: ripe, peeled and cut into thin strips
leaves and thin stems, roughly chopped

content.text: Place {{chicken-breast}} chicken breasts in a saucepan and cover with cold, lightly salted water. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 15 to 17 minutes until cooked through. Leave to cool in the water for 5 minutes, then remove and shred with two forks into rough strips.

Stir together the juice of {{lemon}} lemons (or limes), {{fish-sauce}} of fish sauce, {{caster-sugar}} of sugar and {{rapeseed-oil}} of rapeseed oil. Taste: the dressing should be sharp, salty, lightly sweet and pungent. Adjust with more lemon or more sugar to balance.

Combine the shredded chicken, mango strips, cucumber and spring onion in a large bowl. Pour the dressing over and toss. Add the coriander, mint if using, and chilli flakes if using. Toss again and serve immediately on plates or a large sharing bowl.

items.cause: Fish sauce is very high in salt.
items.fix: Start with 1.5 tablespoons of fish sauce and taste before adding the full amount. Add extra lemon to balance rather than diluting with more oil.
This is not fixable after cutting. Buy mangoes a few days ahead and ripen at room temperature until they give when gently pressed. Do not refrigerate.

content.text: Chicken and mango salad with a Thai-influenced dressing entered British cafes and restaurants in the 1990s. The dressing follows Thai yam logic: lime, fish sauce, sugar and chilli in balance, one of the most useful dressing formulas in Asian cooking. At home, it is a good use for leftover poached or roast chicken.
